description:
Role Summary 
 The ServiceNow Developer is responsible for designing, developing, configuring, and maintaining ServiceNow solutions that support VERSANT's enterprise technology operations. This role will partner with infrastructure, cloud engineering, security, service management, and business teams to build workflows, integrations, automations, and applications that improve operational efficiency and service delivery.
 The ideal candidate has strong experience developing within the ServiceNow platform, including ITSM, CMDB, Service Catalog, Flow Designer, Integration Hub, and custom application development. This individual will play a key role in automating business and operational processes while ensuring platform scalability, performance, and maintainability.
 As a cloud-first media company, VERSANT is increasingly focused on automation, operational excellence, and service integration. This role will help connect ServiceNow with cloud
 platforms, infrastructure services, monitoring systems, identity providers, and enterprise applications to create streamlined and automated workflows.
 Responsibilities 
 ServiceNow Development & Configuration 
 · Design, develop, and maintain ServiceNow applications, workflows, forms, portals, and platform customizations.
 · Configure and extend ServiceNow modules while adhering to platform best practices and upgrade-safe development standards.
 · Develop and maintain business rules, client scripts, UI policies, UI actions, Script Includes, Flow Designer workflows, and integrations.
 · Build reusable components and automation capabilities that improve service delivery and operational efficiency.
 IT Service Management & Workflow Automation 
 · Develop solutions supporting ITSM processes including:
 Incident Management
 Change Management
 Problem Management
 Request Fulfillment
 Knowledge Management
 · Automate service delivery processes using Flow Designer, Integration Hub, and custom workflows.
 · Partner with stakeholders to identify opportunities for automation and process improvement.
 CMDB & Service Mapping 
 · Support and enhance the Configuration Management Database (CMDB).
 · Develop integrations that improve configuration item discovery, data quality, and service visibility.
 · Assist with service mapping initiatives and dependency modeling.
 · Ensure CMDB accuracy and alignment with operational and governance requirements.
 Platform Integrations 
 · Design and develop integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise platforms including:
 AWS and cloud platforms
 Identity and access management systems
 Monitoring and observability platforms
 Infrastructure and automation tools
 Enterprise business applications
 · Utilize REST, SOAP, APIs, Integration Hub, and event-driven architectures to connect systems and automate workflows.
 Cloud & Infrastructure Operations Integration 
 · Support ServiceNow workflows that integrate with cloud operations, infrastructure services, and operational tooling.
 · Develop automation that supports provisioning requests, operational approvals, incident workflows, and service delivery processes.
 · Partner with cloud engineering and operations teams to improve visibility and automation across technology platforms.
 Platform Governance & Continuous Improvement 
 · Follow ServiceNow development standards, security practices, and platform governance guidelines.
 · Participate in platform upgrades, testing, and release management activities.
 · Contribute to platform documentation, technical standards, and operational procedures.
 · Evaluate new ServiceNow capabilities and recommend enhancements that improve business value.

 · Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
 · 3+ years of hands-on ServiceNow development experience.
 · Strong experience with:
 ServiceNow ITSM
 CMDB
 Service Catalog
 Flow Designer
 Integration Hub
 Discovery
 · Experience developing:
 Business Rules
 Script Includes
 Client Scripts
 UI Policies
 UI Actions
 REST and SOAP integrations
 · Strong JavaScript development skills.
 · Experience working with APIs, integrations, and automation frameworks.
 · Experience supporting enterprise IT operations and service management processes.
 · Understanding of cloud infrastructure, infrastructure operations, and enterprise technology environments.
 · Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

 As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with a VERSANT Media employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. VERSANT Media's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.
 If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require support throughout the application and/or recruitment process as a result of your disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation. You can submit your request to candidateaccessibility@versantmedia.com .
 VERSANT Media is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. We include a good faith pay range for each position to comply with applicable state and local pay transparency laws and to promote equity across our organization. Actual compensation will be based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, experience, and location and may include additional forms of compensation and benefits such as health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, etc.
 VERSANT Media is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at VERSANT via-email, the Internet, or in any form and/or method without a valid written Statement of Work in place for this position from VERSANT's Talent Acquisition team will be deemed the sole property of VERSANT. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by VERSANT as a result of the referral or through other means.
